delete.summary: Delete a library and everything indexed from it (admin)

post.summary: Queue a scan of this library (admin)
post.description: Returns immediately with the current status. Poll GET /libraries/{id}/scan until state is idle.

get.summary: Status of the latest scan of this library
Browse or search items
get.description: Without kind or parentId, lists movies and shows. With parentId set to a show, lists its seasons and season-less episodes; set to a season, lists its episodes.

get.summary: Item detail with files, streams, and children
Search TMDB (and AniList for anime) for possible matches (admin)

post.summary: Apply a chosen match and refetch metadata (admin)
post.description: Movies and TV shows take tmdbId. Anime shows take anilistId, tmdbId, and/or seasonOffset.

get.summary: The episode that follows this one in its show
Cached artwork, optionally resized
Server settings (admin). Secrets are masked.
Text subtitle tracks available for a file
Direct play: the original file with byte-range support
get.description: Send `Range: bytes=a-b` for partial content. Players that cannot set headers may pass the bearer token as `?access_token=`.

post.summary: Choose direct play, remux, or transcode for a file and device profile
post.description: Direct play returns the file URL. Remux and transcode create an HLS session and return its master playlist URL.

get.summary: HLS master playlist for a session
HLS media playlist, init segment, or media segment
get.description: Starts ffmpeg on first request and waits up to 20 seconds for the requested file.

delete.summary: Stop a session and delete its segments

get.summary: A subtitle track as WebVTT, converted from its source on first request

post.summary: Report the playback position of a movie or episode
post.description: Positions at or past 90% of the duration mark the item watched. Send every few seconds and on pause or stop.

put.summary: Mark a movie or episode watched or unwatched

get.summary: In-progress movies and episodes, most recent first
All profiles (admin)

delete.summary: Delete a profile and its sessions and watch state (admin). You cannot delete yourself.

get.summary: Provider configuration and last refresh

post.summary: Pull channels and guide from the provider now (admin)

get.summary: Live channel categories
Live channels with what is on now and next
One channel
Programmes for a channel in a time window

post.summary: Choose a raw TS relay or live HLS for a channel and device profile
post.description: Profiles that list the `ts` container get the relay URL. Others get a live HLS session: video copied, audio as stereo AAC. With `programmeId`, a finished programme on a catch-up channel is packaged as seekable HLS for every device.

get.summary: The channel's MPEG-TS stream, relayed from the provider
get.description: One provider connection per channel is shared by every viewer and closes shortly after the last one leaves. Players that cannot set headers may pass `?access_token=`.

get.summary: Live HLS playlist or segment
get.description: `index.m3u8` is a sliding window of the last six 4-second segments; `seg-N.ts` are the segments. The first request starts ffmpeg.
